lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×50

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Thank you, Commander.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: For helping me out once again.
I'm sorry to be the bearer of bad news.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: No, it's okay.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I'm grateful all the same.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: At the very least,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: they were able to set foot on their fabled Ark.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I'm sure they died feeling they'd accomplished something.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: It's kind of funny when you think about it.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Two entirely different worlds on each side of a wall.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: It never really stuck out to me as unjust before,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: and I never tried to do anything about it either.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Now, however, my thoughts have changed.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: What...?!

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Commander, are you listening to the broadcast?
No, what is it?

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: On the radio, they're claiming that

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: there are zero casualties.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Can you believe that?

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: My goodness,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: this is just too much.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: thank you for doing me this favor.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I thought I had finally repaid you what I owed,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: but it seems I may still be in your debt.
Don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I'm not just blowing hot air.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: If you ever need help, please come to me.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Whatever it is, I'll help you. No matter what's at stake.
Okay, thank you.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Stay safe,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: and thank you, again.
